clubs.name: Coding Club
clubs.desc: Our coding club brings kids together to solve problems, share ideas, encourage each other through mistakes, and applaud for each other's successes.

clubs.name: Chess Club
clubs.desc: Welcome to the Ontario Student Led Chess Association (OntarioSLCA), where we believe in using chess to make a difference. As a province-wide organization, our goal is to unite students across Ontario through the love of chess, fostering both community and competition. We organize and host a variety of chess tournaments, including the prestigious Halton Chess Championship, which brings together top talent from across the region.

clubs.name: Newspaper Club
clubs.desc: Help write the school's newspaper! We require comic artists, story writers, and photographers!
